name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.StructuredSeed.Internal.bucket_count_upper
role: The rounded bucket count satisfies `B κ ≤ m κ * κ + 1`; glue for the JLS allocation. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.StructuredSeed.Internal.bucket_count_lower
role: The rounded bucket count covers the allocation: `m κ * κ ≤ B κ * W κ`; glue. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.StructuredSeed.Internal.prefactor_eventually_le_two_pow
role: The construction prefactor `(κ+1)*B κ+1` is eventually at most `2^κ`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.StructuredSeed.Internal.binomial_ratio_quarter
role: For positive B,r with `4*exp(1)*N ≤ B*r` and `κ ≤ r`, the ratio `choose(N,r)/B^r` is at most `4⁻¹^κ`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.StructuredSeed.Internal.smallset_bucket_tail_quarter
role: For κ≥12 and Γ κ≤B κ, every fixed set of size at most Γ κ has some overloaded bucket with probability at most `B κ * 4⁻¹^κ`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.StructuredSeed.Internal.capacity_bucket_tail_quarter
role: For κ≥12, uniform placement exceeds the rounded capacity in some bucket with probability at most `B κ * 4⁻¹^κ`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.StructuredSeed.Internal.cond1_single_le_quarter
role: If `4*cLoc ≤ log₂(n κ)`, one fixed-index bad-count failure has probability at most 1/4. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.StructuredSeed.Internal.cond1_repetitions_fixed_index
role: At a fixed complete index, the probability that every independent repetition satisfies Cond1 is at most `4⁻¹^κ`, under the logarithmic locality bound. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.StructuredSeed.Internal.cond1_all_fixed_index
role: Under the logarithmic locality bound, the full seed-core law at each fixed index has simultaneous Cond1 probability at most `4⁻¹^κ`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.StructuredSeed.Internal.cond1_all_joint
role: Under the logarithmic locality bound, simultaneous Cond1 under the actual joint law has probability at most `4⁻¹^κ`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.StructuredSeed.Internal.cond3_joint_le_quarter_pow
role: For κ≥12, common capacity failure under the actual joint law has probability at most `B κ * 4⁻¹^κ`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.StructuredSeed.Internal.cond2_sparse_joint_le_quarter_pow
role: For κ≥12 and Γ κ≤B κ, each joint Cond2-and-not-Cond1 event has probability at most `B κ * 4⁻¹^κ`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.StructuredSeed.Params.jointLaw_prob_eq_uprob
role: The probability of any event under jointLaw equals its probability after the index and seed cores are applied to one uniform raw product draw. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 19-21]; semantic probability reader glue.
